title: Optimistic update
name: optimisticUpdate
english: Show the change at once and put the old value back if saving it fails.

inputs.name: update
inputs.sentence: The change to show at once.

outputs.name: snapshot
outputs.sentence: The last saved value, kept while a change is saving.

events.sentence: A change is shown before it is saved.
Saving failed, so the old value comes back.

wraps.concept: useMutation onMutate (snapshot and write), onError (roll back), onSettled (confirm)
wraps.adapter: The write input is the mutation function; APPLY is onMutate, ROLLBACK is onError and COMMIT is onSettled with the server's answer.

phrases: show the change before it saves

signals.sentence: This function shows a change before saving it and puts the old value back by hand.
